candidates.title: Fire in the car park next to a metro station suspends service
candidates.search_snippet: Fire in the car park next to a metro station suspends service.
candidates.source_content: A fire broke out in the car park next to the metro station on Tuesday evening. The operator suspended service between two stations as a precaution while firefighters put out the fire. Service resumed about an hour later; the station, the track and the trains were not damaged.
